a.lede: Ahead of the midterms, WIRED talked to New York City’s mayor about data centers, AI in schools, and the future of the Democratic party.
a.title: ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers

b.lede: At a Brooklyn midterm party five days before Election Day, every conversation, from a council member’s fireside chat to a debate about the Democratic Party, kept circling back to AI and data centers.
b.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn
